subject: POC timeline & milestones — kickoff + weekly check-ins
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: POC timeline & milestones — kickoff + weekly check-ins

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the proposed next steps for the POC so we can align on success criteria and schedule: 

Summary of goals (as we discussed):
- Validate ingestion & latency on your typical document mix (contracts, specs, manuals)
- Confirm embedding accuracy for search/ranking use case
- Measure token cost and per-query latency under a 250 qps simulated test
- Confirm integration pattern for private deployment (VPC) and key management

Proposed success criteria: 
1) 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for interactive reads (our target based on your SLA)
2) Embedding recall @ top-5 >= 85% vs. your ground-truth set
3) End-to-end nightly batch indexing within your 2-hour window
4) No PII exfiltration observed in audit logs; KMS integration validated

POC timeline (proposal):
- Kickoff: Mon 2026-03-08 — onboarding, account access, data transfer plan
- Week 1 (03/08–03/12): Ingest sample corpus, baseline run, and initial latency checks
- Week 2 (03/15–03/19): Embedding quality evaluation + prompts tuning
- Week 3 (03/22–03/26): Load testing (250 qps simulation) and cost runups
- Week 4 (03/29–04/02): Final readout + next-step recommendation

Ownership & meetings:
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (technical lead) — responsible for setup, benchmarking, and tuning
- Acme: Emily Park (engineering lead) — data access and validation
- Weekly check-ins: 30-min cadence, Fridays 10:00 PT (starting 03/12)

I've attached a draft POC plan workbook and a starter SOW for your legal review. Can you confirm:
1) Kickoff date 03/08 works for your team?
2) Emily can share a sample dataset (S3 link or share via Drive) by 03/05?
3) Any additional success metrics we should include?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.xlsx, SOW_draft_acme.pdf

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Quick answers below and a couple notes: 

Kickoff & timing:
- 03/08 kickoff works for Acme. We'll block calendar for 1 hour (onboarding + account access).
- Weekly check-ins on Fridays 10:00 PT are fine.

Data and contacts:
- Emily will share an S3 read-only bucket by 03/05. She'll include a small ground-truth set for embedding evals.

Success criteria:
- The metrics look good. One ask: can we add a cost-per-1k-queries estimate for the load test so we can model TCO?

Other notes:
- We will need a basic non-prod IP allowlist for your agents to hit our test environment. Can Jonas send the connection requirements?

I'll review the SOW and loop in legal if we need changes. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Cheers,
Liam
